$comment: The one place for the default approval vocabulary (REQ-W1-019, architecture §3.3). A project overrides any of the three lists in project.json:enforcement.approval_vocabulary, read from the reviewed line (origin/{production}); uncommitted edits are ignored. Terms are matched on word boundaries after NFKD, accent stripping and casefolding. Negation wins over approval; kind = prod needs an approval term AND a prod term (D-10).
